import unittest from solution import notes_to_markup class NotesToMarkupTests(unittest.TestCase): def test_empty_and_single_paragraph(self): self.assertEqual(notes_to_markup(""), "") self.assertEqual(notes_to_markup("hello"), "

hello

") self.assertEqual(notes_to_markup("one\ntwo"), "

one
two

") def test_all_line_endings_are_equivalent(self): expected = "

a
b

c

" self.assertEqual(notes_to_markup("a\r\nb\r\r\nc"), expected) self.assertEqual(notes_to_markup("a\rb\n\nc"), expected) def test_multiple_empty_lines_do_not_create_empty_paragraphs(self): self.assertEqual(notes_to_markup("first\n\n\n\nsecond"), "

first

second

") self.assertEqual(notes_to_markup("\n\nfirst\n\nsecond\n\n"), "

first

second

") self.assertEqual(notes_to_markup("\n\n\n"), "") def test_escapes_user_text_but_not_generated_tags(self): text = "<&> 'quoted' \"double\"\nnext & line" expected = ("

<&> 'quoted' "double"" "
next & line

") self.assertEqual(notes_to_markup(text), expected) def test_literal_markup_is_escaped(self): self.assertEqual(notes_to_markup("

x


"), "

<p>x</p><br>

") def test_rejects_non_strings(self): for value in (None, b"text", 1, [], True): with self.subTest(value=value): with self.assertRaises(TypeError): notes_to_markup(value) if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()
